scope: Bounded review of directly relevant primary studies; not an exhaustive priority search.

references.title: Connecting single-cell transcriptomes to projectomes in the mouse visual cortex
references.established: Integrated separate Patch-seq and whole-neuron morphology datasets through cell-type classification; reported relationships of gene expression and anatomical location with neuronal projection targets.
references.boundary: Cortical multimodal integration is established prior art. Its separate cohorts do not imply transcriptomes and complete axons were measured in every same neuron.

references.title: Projectome-based characterization of hypothalamic peptidergic neurons in male mice
references.established: Measured whole-brain projections from over 7000 hypothalamic neurons and characterized projectome types.
references.boundary: Some Synarch trace data derive from this prior study; displaying or reassembling these measurements is not a new anatomical discovery by Synarch.

references.title: A spatial and projection-based transcriptomic atlas of paraventricular hypothalamic cell types
references.established: Integrated PVH molecular classification, spatial profiling and projection-enriched samples for parabrachial and spinal cord populations.
references.boundary: The pilot reuses this study. Public pooled projection RNA records and separate spatial cohorts must retain their distinct observation units.

references.title: Integrating barcoded neuroanatomy with spatial transcriptional profiling enables identification of gene correlates of projections
references.established: BARseq2 jointly measured gene expression and projection destinations in individual cortical neurons and identified molecular associations.
references.boundary: Synarch's cortical development scores use data from this existing study; they are not evidence of newly discovered hypothalamic circuits.

proposed_new_contribution: A demonstrably transferable method that uses incomplete biological measurements to improve predictions of independently withheld hypothalamic connectivity properties over strong published and simple controls, with useful uncertainty and new biological insight.
current_pilot_claim: A provenance-backed PVH population evidence map and exploratory raw-gene prediction of retrograde collection labels across pooled samples. Not an independent-animal validation or complete circuit reconstruction.

journal_assessment.summary: Nature assesses original research for major scientific importance and broad interest. A future validated breakthrough could be considered; journal placement cannot be inferred from the project ambition or a small pilot. Nature and Nature Neuroscience are distinct journals.

user_constraints: No lab collaboration or further author contact
Use existing public data and explicitly labeled simulations
Do not treat cross-dataset inferred matches as same-cell measurements
